description: This file defines a collection of functions to generate JSON structures within CMake scripts, including callbacks for Json object and array handling, as well as literal values and key-value pairs. It facilitates JSON serialization and deserialization logic directly in CMake.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Main function to create a JSON object with optional nested structures by applying provided callback functions.

methods.name: json_obj_begin
methods.description: Callback to append the opening brace '{' for a JSON object.

methods.name: json_obj_end
methods.description: Callback to append the closing brace '}' for a JSON object.

methods.name: json_array_begin
methods.description: Callback to append the opening bracket '[' for a JSON array.

methods.name: json_array_end
methods.description: Callback to append the closing bracket ']' for a JSON array.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_begin
methods.description: Callback to handle the beginning of a key-value pair within a JSON object.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_end
methods.description: Callback to handle the end of a key-value pair, adding commas if needed.

methods.name: json_array_element_end
methods.description: Callback to handle the end of an array element, adding commas if needed.

methods.name: json_literal
methods.description: Handles serialization of literal JSON values such as null, true, false, and numbers or strings.
